from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, traceback
from typing import Any

F2 = pathlib.Path(os.environ['F2_ROOT']).resolve()
CTRL = pathlib.Path(os.environ['CTRL_ROOT']).resolve()
F2_SHA = os.environ['F2_SHA']
OUT = pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT'])
NEMO = pathlib.Path(os.environ['NEMO'])
NEMO_MODEL = pathlib.Path(os.environ['NEMO_MODEL'])
PIPER_MODEL = pathlib.Path(os.environ['PIPER_MODEL'])
PIPER_CONFIG = pathlib.Path(os.environ['PIPER_CONFIG'])

def sha256(path: pathlib.Path) -> str:
    h=hashlib.sha256();
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024), b''): h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()

def blob(repo: pathlib.Path, path: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse',f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True).strip()

def load(path: pathlib.Path, name: str):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); assert spec and spec.loader; sys.modules[name]=mod; spec.loader.exec_module(mod); return mod

report: dict[str, Any] = {
  'schema':'T4_G4_REAL_ASR_TTS_CAUSAL_REENTRY_VPS/v1',
  'semantic_key':'29bf28d8f3b3cec294de2126c002b90fedbacdec961e823503c2c4d8f11ddbdc',

    'physical_microphone':0,'physical_speaker':0,'human_heard_output':0,'true_streaming_partial_asr_latency':0,
    'physical_presence':0,'unifieddb_write':0,'gwt_jspace':0,'effect':0,'training':0,'whole_voice_e2e':0,'whole_product':0
  }
}
stage='BOOT'
try:
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(F2),'rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip()==F2_SHA
    sys.path.insert(0,str(CTRL/'tools/trigger4')); sys.path.insert(0,str(F2)); sys.path.insert(0,str(F2/'src'))
    stage='LOAD_G2_ASR_HELPERS'
    g2=load(CTRL/'tools/trigger4/t7_fdx_system_slice_g2.py','t4_g2_runtime_helpers')
    base=g2.base
    assert sha256(NEMO_MODEL)==base.NEMO_MODEL_SHA256
    assert sha256(PIPER_MODEL)==base.PIPER_MODEL_SHA256
    from piper import PiperVoice
    voice=PiperVoice.load(str(PIPER_MODEL), config_path=str(PIPER_CONFIG), use_cuda=False)
    network_attempts=[]
    base.install_network_guard(network_attempts)
    stage='REAL_LOCAL_ASR'
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='t4-g4-asr-') as td:
        td=pathlib.Path(td)
        hold_wav=td/'hold.wav'; interrupt_wav=td/'interrupt.wav'
        hold_fixture=base.write_piper_fixture(voice,'Moment, ich bin noch nicht fertig.',hold_wav)
        interrupt_fixture=base.write_piper_fixture(voice,'Stopp, beantworte stattdessen die neue Frage.',interrupt_wav)
        p,so,se,o,cmd,start=base.start_asr(NEMO,NEMO_MODEL,hold_wav,td,'g4_hold'); hold=base.finish_asr(p,so,se,o); hold['started_ns']=start; hold['command']=cmd
        p,so,se,o,cmd,start=base.start_asr(NEMO,NEMO_MODEL,interrupt_wav,td,'g4_interrupt'); interrupt=base.finish_asr(p,so,se,o); interrupt['started_ns']=start; interrupt['command']=cmd
    assert hold.get('transcript') and interrupt.get('transcript')
    stage='LOAD_G4_CHAIN'
    g4=load(F2/'research/local_voice/tools/falsify_composed_voice_slice_barge_restart_heard_reentry.py','t4_g4_chain')
    original_input=g4._input
    def injected_input(session, **kw):
        pid=kw.get('packet_id')
        if pid=='input-a-0': kw['text']=hold['transcript']
        elif pid=='input-b-0': kw['text']=(interrupt['transcript'].split()[0] if interrupt['transcript'].split() else 'Stopp')
        elif pid=='input-b-1': kw['text']=interrupt['transcript']
        return original_input(session, **kw)
    g4._input=injected_input
    from frankenstein2.voice_packet_cortex import VoicePacketCortex
    original_queue=VoicePacketCortex.queue_output
    tts_packets=[]
    def queue_with_real_tts(self,*args,**kwargs):
        pkt=original_queue(self,*args,**kwargs)
        text=kwargs.get('text_segment')
        if text is None and len(args)>=4: text=args[3]
        h=hashlib.sha256(); samples=0; rates=set(); chunks=0
        for chunk in voice.synthesize(str(text)):
            import numpy as np
            arr=np.asarray(chunk.audio_float_array,dtype=np.float32)
            if arr.ndim!=1 or arr.size<=0 or not np.isfinite(arr).all(): raise AssertionError('PIPER_G4_INVALID_AUDIO')
            raw=arr.tobytes(order='C'); h.update(raw); samples += int(arr.size); rates.add(int(chunk.sample_rate)); chunks += 1
        if not samples or len(rates)!=1: raise AssertionError('PIPER_G4_NO_OR_MIXED_AUDIO')
        tts_packets.append({'packet_id':pkt.packet_id,'turn_id':pkt.turn_id,'text_sha256':hashlib.sha256(str(text).encode()).hexdigest(),'audio_float32_sha256':h.hexdigest(),'sample_rate':next(iter(rates)),'sample_count':samples,'chunk_count':chunks})
        return pkt
    VoicePacketCortex.queue_output=queue_with_real_tts
    stage='G4_CAUSAL_EXECUTION'
    try:
        os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']=F2_SHA
        g4_report=g4.run_discriminator()
    finally:
        VoicePacketCortex.queue_output=original_queue
    assert g4_report.get('result')=='NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE', g4_report
    assert len(tts_packets)>=2, tts_packets
    assert not network_attempts, network_attempts

      'classification':'BOUNDED_OWNER_VPS_REAL_LOCAL_ASR_INPUT_PLUS_REAL_LOCAL_TTS_GENERATION_IN_G4_CAUSAL_REENTRY_CHAIN',

        'g4_tool_blob':blob(F2,'research/local_voice/tools/falsify_composed_voice_slice_barge_restart_heard_reentry.py'),
        'controller_g2_helper_blob':blob(CTRL,'tools/trigger4/t7_fdx_system_slice_g2.py')
      },
      'runtime_subjects':{
        'nemotron_model_sha256':sha256(NEMO_MODEL),'nemotron_binary_sha256':sha256(NEMO),
        'piper_model_sha256':sha256(PIPER_MODEL),'piper_config_sha256':sha256(PIPER_CONFIG)
      },
      'real_asr':{
        'hold_transcript':hold['transcript'],'interrupt_transcript':interrupt['transcript'],
        'hold_fixture':hold_fixture,'interrupt_fixture':interrupt_fixture,
        'causal_injection':{'input-a-0':'hold_transcript','input-b-0':'interrupt_first_token','input-b-1':'interrupt_transcript'},
        'true_partial_streaming_observed':False
      },
      'real_tts_packet_generation':tts_packets,
      'g4_causal_observations':g4_report.get('observations'),
      'g4_composition':g4_report.get('composition'),
      'network_guard':{'enabled_during_local_inference':True,'attempts':network_attempts,'external_inference_api_calls_observed':0},
      'promotion_candidates':{
        'owner_vps_real_asr_to_packet_chain_component_evidence':1,
        'owner_vps_real_tts_generation_bound_to_voice_output_packet_ids':1,
        'packet_barge_restart_heard_reentry_causal_chain_runtime_evidence':1
      },
      'scope_fence':'Headless VPS causal composition only. ASR inputs are synthesized fixtures; TTS bytes are generated and bound to packet IDs but not physically played/heard. No physical-device, true streaming-partial, whole-voice, effect, GWT/J-Space, training or whole-product promotion.'
    })
except AssertionError as exc:
    report.update({'result':'COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_HARNESS_DEFECT_REQUIRES_TRIAGE','failure_class':'PRODUCT_NEGATIVE_OR_EVIDENCE_INVALID_REQUIRES_TRIAGE','failure_stage':stage,'error':str(exc),'traceback':traceback.format_exc()[-8000:]})
except Exception as exc:
    infra_stages={'BOOT','LOAD_G2_ASR_HELPERS','REAL_LOCAL_ASR'}
    report.update({'result':'BLOCKED','failure_class':'INFRA_AUTH_TRANSPORT_QUOTA' if stage in infra_stages else 'EVIDENCE_INVALID','failure_stage':stage,'error':f'{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}','traceback':traceback.format_exc()[-8000:]})
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if report['result']=='NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE' else 2)
PY
